I have performed tauba also. Please tell me whether my sin is washed out if not.Please tell me what is the way to perform tauba for this act, and tell me the way to safe from this act in future. Question: I had done a mistake of sodomy with my friend.Two,three times i have involved in this act! I have performed tauba also. Please tell me whether my sin is washed out if not.Please tell me what is the way to perform tauba for this act, and tell me the way to safe from this act in future. Answer ID: 16614 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1674/1333/L=1430) Perform two rak?ah as Salatut Taubah, repent to Allah sincerely with firm intention not to repeat the sin again, in-sha-Allah your sins will be purged away. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
